'''Razoronns''' were [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predators native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. They were one of the few [[Diet/Legends|carnivore]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that could take down a [[Gapillian grazer]] by itself. They never got too near to Ord Mantell settlements, wandering the planet's [[Beach/Legends|beaches]] and meadows in search of prey; if not teased, they did not attack [[Human/Legends|humans]] who came near them, but they could present a serious threat to anything smaller than an armored [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttlecraft]] if enraged.
